name: safespace-mcp
description: SafeSpace MCP — the AI safety gateway for an agent's external surface. A provider-agnostic safety envelope (input sanitize + untrusted-content tagging, tier/scope/burst/recipient egress gates, autonomy hardening, run_id session forensics, tokens behind a SecretBackend, a full audit trail) between an AI agent and any source it touches. 111 tools across Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Calendar, Contacts, YouTube + Analytics, Tasks, Sheets, Slides, Forms — the flagship reference connector), GitHub read (repos, issues, PRs, commits, file content + PR diffs — every field sanitize-wrapped) + write (the 2nd OAuth source; issue create/comment/edit + PR open/merge + label triage behind default-deny repo allowlists), Notion read (search / pages / blocks / databases — every title, block, and property sanitize-wrapped), a keyless SSRF-gated web_fetch + a default-deny path-gated fs_read, and LINE / Telegram / Discord bot push. Three connector classes: OAuth-account, keyless, service-token. Tier-based tool exposure (read|write|share); tokens in the macOS Keychain or an encrypted file. Apache-2.0.
author: lolxl
